radio.deliver.what: hand a node's radio one frame directly, as received or as a chosen kind of failed reception, to test the firmware's receive path without the channel deciding anything

params.name: node
params.what: the node whose radio receives it; it needs firmware running

params.name: hex
params.what: the frame, header first, as hex digits

params.name: as
params.what: ok (the default), crc_error, header_error, no_crc (the header said the payload has no CRC), next_before_read or next_during_read (the next frame's header arriving in continuous receive before or during the firmware's read of this one)

radio.deliver.answers: `delivered` is false when the node has no firmware or its chip does not read that kind, which is an answer rather than a refusal. The next_* kinds need a frame already received and not yet read, so they follow an ok delivery.

example.what: a frame whose header said it carries no CRC
